Replay vectors of porting unit U7 (RoutingBoard, board/optimize, board/actions, undo), replayed by
crates/fr-engine/tests/board_replay.rs (test routing_operations_match_java; operations in
tests/common/routing_ops.rs). Generated by RoutingGen.java (+ ../board/BoardGen.java) with
reference/bin/freerouting-parity.jar, time limits disabled.

Build the generator (from the workspace root):

  J=reference/jdk25/bin; D=crates/fr-engine/testdata; F=reference/freerouting/fixtures; P=reference/parity-baseline
  $J/javac -cp reference/bin/freerouting-parity.jar -d /tmp/routinggen $D/board/BoardGen.java $D/routing/RoutingGen.java
  run() { $J/java -Dfreerouting.parity.disableTimeLimits=true -cp reference/bin/freerouting-parity.jar:/tmp/routinggen RoutingGen "$@"; }

Committed vectors (arguments: dsn, ses, angle restriction, seed, operations per phase):

  run $F/Issue313-FastTest.dsn $F/Issue313-FastTest.ses 45 11 8 > $D/routing/i313_45.txt
  run $F/Issue313-FastTest.dsn $F/Issue313-FastTest.ses 90 12 8 > $D/routing/i313_90.txt
  run $F/Issue313-FastTest.dsn $F/Issue313-FastTest.ses none 13 8 > $D/routing/i313_none.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm02.dsn $P/DAC2020_bm02.ses keep 14 8 > $D/routing/bm02.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm08.dsn $P/DAC2020_bm08.ses keep 15 8 > $D/routing/bm08.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm09.dsn $P/DAC2020_bm09.ses keep 16 8 > $D/routing/bm09.txt
  run $F/Issue690-ecc83.dsn $F/Issue690-ecc83.ses keep 17 8 > $D/routing/ecc83.txt
  run $F/Issue742-tastexx-pcb.dsn $F/Issue742-tastexx-pcb.ses keep 18 8 > $D/routing/tastexx.txt
  run $F/Issue026-J2_reference.dsn $F/Issue026-J2_reference.ses keep 19 8 > $D/routing/j2.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm05.dsn $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm05.ses 90 26 8 > $D/routing/bm05_90.txt
  run $F/Issue368-CorneyIslandWireless_input_design.dsn $F/Issue368-CorneyIslandWireless_output_session.ses keep 23 8 > $D/routing/corney.txt
  JOPTS=-Dstepped=true: run $F/Issue313-FastTest.dsn $F/Issue313-FastTest.ses 45 22 6 > $D/routing/i313_45_stepped.txt

Larger sets (not committed; FR_ROUTING_VECTORS=<file>[:<file>...] cargo test -p fr-engine --release
--test board_replay routing_operations), e.g. with operations per phase 20..30 and other seeds:

  run $F/Issue103-Board-Routed.dsn - keep 7 20 > /tmp/i103.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm06.dsn $P/DAC2020_bm06.ses keep 7 20 > /tmp/bm06.txt
  run $F/Issue508-DAC2020_bm07.dsn $P/DAC2020_bm07.ses keep 7 20 > /tmp/bm07.txt
  run $F/Issue593-BBD_Mars-64.dsn $F/Issue593-BBD_Mars-64.ses keep 7 20 > /tmp/mars.txt

Options: a 6th argument "expand" writes all dumps expanded instead of hashed (for debugging with
FR_REPLAY_DIFF_DIR); -Ddumpall=true dumps after every operation; -Dstepped=true replaces
optChangedArea by its loop executed step by step (TTNEW/TTEMPTY/TTPULL/TTSMOOTH/TTKEEP/ENDMARK)
with a dump after every step; -Ddebugtrace=<id> prints the line object identities of the stages of
TraceTightener90.pullTight for that trace (stderr, stepped mode).

Note: with time limits disabled, TraceTightenerAnyAngle may not terminate on larger boards (e.g.
Issue103 with angle "none"); Java relies on the 1000 ms pull tight limit there.
